course.title: Hazards and Disaster Management

content.value: “The COVID-19 has led to a dramatic loss of human life worldwide and presents an unprecedented challenge to public health, food systems and the world of work”. Prepare a disaster management cycle suggesting activities to reduce the adverse impact of COVID-19 in Bangladesh.
